title: alnus viridis f. subvestita
intro: Alnus viridis f. subvestita, commonly known as green alder, is a variant of the green alder tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of green alder include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and demulcent, providing relief from coughs and sore throats. Bioactive constituents of green alder include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
